region_label: Nature Coast — Cedar Key, Crystal River, Homosassa
notes: DIRECT ANSWER ON CEDAR KEY: yes, Cedar Key works for nine people — the earlier 'ceiling is 4BR' conclusion was an artifact of searching at 6-8 bedrooms. An Airbnb map-bounded search of the island itself turns up three genuine 5-bedroom properties (Tri-Sister Suites, Island Breeze Getaway, and the Gulf-front 'Dolphins & Ocean Breezes' condo at Old Fenimore Mill) plus three strong 4-bedrooms that really sleep 10-12 (Whispering Waves, Gulf Landing, Fenimore Mill 6DE). There is no 6-bedroom whole house on the island and never will be; 5BR is the true ceiling. THE STANDOUT: Tri-Sister Suites is the only property found in the entire region whose bed layout is exactly what the family asked for — 3 kings and 2 queens, 5 bedrooms, 5 private baths, max 10 guests, downtown, and it came back live in a dated Dec 19-27 2026 search at $4,505 for 8 nights. The catch is that it is three separate apartments in one restored 1872 building rather than one house with a shared living room. AVAILABILITY CAVEAT, IMPORTANT: only three Cedar Key properties returned in the dated Dec 19-27 2026 search (Tri-Sister, Fenimore Mill 6DE, and a 4BR duplex cabin whose host caps it at 8 guests, so it was excluded). Gulf Landing, Island Breeze, Whispering Waves and Dolphins & Ocean Breezes all appear in an UNDATED island search but not the dated one; Gulf Landing and Island Breeze do appear in a Nov 14-22 2026 dated search. That pattern says the calendars are simply not open 16 months out, not that the houses are booked. Those four need a phone call — McCormick Management 352-543-9161, Pelican Vacation Home 352-543-5307. AGENCY CHECK: Pelican Vacation Home lists ~90 properties and has exactly ONE at 4BR+ (the Sister Suites bundle). McCormick's largest is Whispering Waves at 4BR/sleeps 12. So the island agencies add nothing above 5BR. BEST BED-MATH ANYWHERE IN THE REGION: Hampton House in Old Homosassa — all five bedrooms are split kings that the host will set up as either a king or two twins on request, i.e. exactly 3 kings + 2 twin rooms if you ask. 5.5 baths, waterfront, $7,213/8 nights, confirmed in the dated search. OTHER REGIONS: Crystal River and Homosassa are rich at 5-6BR and December is peak manatee season at Kings Bay; Steinhatchee has real 4-5BR inventory including houses inside the 35-acre Steinhatchee Landing Resort (Anchor Hill on Airbnb, Southern Pines Lodge via Steinhatchee Retreats) where extra cottages can be added for overflow; Dunnellon's Rainbow River has the region's most luxurious houses but at 2-3x the price and no Gulf. Suwannee, Horseshoe Beach, Yankeetown/Inglis, Chiefland and Fanning Springs returned essentially nothing at 4BR+ for these dates — the previous pass was right about those. METHOD/BLOCKS: Airbnb blocks WebFetch but curl with a browser user-agent works; all dated totals here come from parsing the embedded data-deferred-state JSON on Airbnb dated search URLs for checkin=2026-12-19 / checkout=2026-12-27 / adults=9, and bed configurations come from the sleepingArrangements block on individual room pages. Vrbo listing pages returned HTTP 429 today, so Southern Pines Lodge details come from the agency site only. All 'total_est' values marked search_listed are real 8-night quoted totals before taxes and fees.

properties.name: Tri-Sister Suites — Rose, Kate & Eliza (Lutterloh Building)
properties.compound_note: Three separate Victorian apartments — Rose (2 kings), Kate (1 queen) and Eliza (1 king + 1 queen) — inside one restored 1872 building. They book together as a single bundled listing on Airbnb and as the 'Sister Suites 3-Unit Bundle' direct with Pelican Vacation Home. Each unit has its own kitchen and bath; the group shares a building and a front porch, not a living room.
properties.beds_note: Rose: 2 king bedrooms. Kate: 1 queen bedroom. Eliza: 1 king + 1 queen. 5 bedrooms, 5 full baths, max 10 guests.
properties.price_note: Airbnb dated search for Dec 19-27 2026 quoted $4,505 for 8 nights (was $4,975) before taxes. Direct rate from Pelican is $469/night base, $519 holiday.
amenities: walk to Dock Street and the waterfront
properties.why: This is the single best bed-math fit found anywhere in the region: exactly 3 king bedrooms and 2 queen bedrooms, 5 bedrooms, 5 private baths, max 10 guests — one king per couple, a queen each for two of the twenty-somethings, and the third takes the remaining queen. It is also actually in downtown Cedar Key, walkable to Dock Street, and it showed as bookable in a dated Dec 19-27 2026 search.
properties.cons: It is three separate apartments, not one house — no single big living room or kitchen where all nine gather, which for an eight-night Christmas is a real trade-off. Historic building, some fridge-fan noise noted by the host. No pool, no dock of its own, brand-new listing with no review history on Airbnb.
properties.availability_note: Returned in an Airbnb dated search for checkin 2026-12-19 / checkout 2026-12-27, 9 adults, min 5 bedrooms, with a quoted total of $4,505 for 8 nights.
properties.min_stay_note: Direct listing states festivals and holidays are a three-night minimum; 8 nights clears it.

properties.name: Fenimore Mill 6DE — 'Double Delight' (two units combined)
properties.neighborhood: Old Fenimore Mill condos, Gulf side
properties.beds_note: Bedroom 1: king. Bedroom 2: queen. Bedroom 3: double. Bedroom 4 (a loft inside the master): 2 singles. Living room: 1 trundle bed.
properties.price_note: Airbnb dated search Dec 19-27 2026 quoted $3,345 for 8 nights (was $3,693), before taxes.
properties.why: The largest single unit at any condo complex on Cedar Key — two units knocked together, 4 baths for 9 people, Gulf views, a pool and a fishing dock, and it is genuinely bookable for the actual dates at a low price.
properties.cons: Only 4 bedrooms and only ONE king, so two couples would be in a queen and a double, and the fourth 'bedroom' is a loft open to the master — poor privacy for an adult. Condo, not a house.
properties.availability_note: Returned in the Airbnb dated Dec 19-27 2026 search at $3,345 for 8 nights.

properties.name: Gulf Landing — Waterfront home with elevator
properties.neighborhood: Gulf side, a few blocks from downtown
properties.beds_note: Bedroom 1: king. Bedroom 2: queen + 1 single. Bedroom 3: king + 1 double. Bedroom 4: 2 singles. 7 beds total.
properties.price_note: Not quoted for Dec 2026. An identical 8-night Nov 14-22 2026 dated search quoted $3,346 (was $3,687) — use as the best available proxy.
amenities: two large porches with sunset views
properties.why: The strongest 4-bedroom whole-house on the island: two kings, a queen, waterfront with sunset porches, an elevator (a genuine help for the parents), kayaks and a walk into town. Nine adults fit with two of the twenty-somethings sharing the twin room.
properties.cons: Only 4 bedrooms and only 2 kings — the third couple gets the queen, and the two remaining adults share the twin room or the king-plus-double room. Did not come back in a dated Dec 19-27 2026 search, so availability must be confirmed with the host. Narrow driveway.
properties.availability_note: Absent from the Airbnb dated Dec 19-27 2026 search but present and priced in an otherwise identical Nov 14-22 2026 search — most likely the calendar simply is not open 16 months out. Message the host or check again after the 12-month window opens.

properties.name: Island Breeze Getaway — 5 Bedroom
properties.beds_note: Bedroom 1: king. Bedroom 2: 2 singles. Bedroom 3: king. Bedroom 4: queen. Bedroom 5: 1 single.
properties.price_note: No Dec 2026 quote available. Undated Airbnb search showed $1,672 for 5 nights (~$334/night); the 8-night figure is that rate x 8 and is an estimate only, not a quoted total.
amenities: on-site parking for truck and trailer
properties.why: Proof that a genuine 5-bedroom whole house does exist on Cedar Key, at a fraction of the price of anything comparable elsewhere on this coast. Two kings, a queen and three twins across five rooms is close to the layout the family wants, and it takes all nine.
properties.cons: Only 2 bathrooms for nine adults over eight nights — that is the real problem here. Only 2 kings, so the third couple takes the queen. Not waterfront. Did not appear in a dated Dec 19-27 2026 search, so availability is unproven.
properties.availability_note: Appears in an undated Cedar Key map search at 5BR but not in the Dec 19-27 2026 dated search nor in a Nov 2026 dated search — either booked or the calendar is closed that far out. Confirm with the host.

properties.name: Whispering Waves — Gulf-front stilt house
properties.beds_note: Bedroom 1: king. Bedroom 2: queen. Bedroom 3: queen + 2 bunk beds. Bedroom 4: queen + 2 bunk beds. 8 beds total.
properties.price_note: No Dec 2026 quote. Undated Airbnb search showed $1,711 for 5 nights (~$342/night); the 8-night number is an estimate from that rate, not a quoted total. Also listed at cedarkeytime.com/listings/321897.
amenities: Gulf of Mexico and island views
wheelchair-accessible queen suite with roll-in shower
properties.why: The best-looking house on Cedar Key and the largest property McCormick manages — a brand-new two-storey stilt home with four decks and panoramic Gulf views, sleeping 12 in 4 bedrooms. 5.0 stars over 20 reviews.
properties.cons: Only ONE king. Two of the three couples would be in queen bedrooms that also hold bunk beds, which is not what the family asked for. 4 bedrooms means two twenty-somethings share. Lots of stairs and no elevator — reviewers flag the luggage haul. Not confirmed available for the dates.
properties.availability_note: Present in an undated Cedar Key search but absent from both the Dec 19-27 2026 and Nov 14-22 2026 dated searches. Call McCormick Management at 352-543-9161 to check Dec 2026.

properties.name: Dolphins & Ocean Breezes ('Bubbles Up') — Gulf-front condo
properties.beds_note: Bedroom 1 (master suite): king, 20-ft vaulted ceilings, wall of Gulf windows, ensuite. Bedroom 2: queen, ensuite. Bedroom 3: double. Bedroom 4: queen. Bedroom 5: queen. Loft off the master: queen.
properties.price_note: No Dec 2026 quote. Undated Airbnb search showed $2,200 for 5 nights (~$440/night); the 8-night number is an estimate from that rate.
amenities: community pool and dock at Old Fenimore Mill
properties.why: A 2,000 sq ft five-bedroom Gulf-front condo with a spectacular vaulted king master looking straight out at the water, walkable to downtown Cedar Key, at a reasonable rate for nine adults.
properties.cons: Only 1 king and only 2 bathrooms across 5 bedrooms — thin for nine adults over eight nights. One of the five 'bedrooms' is an open loft off the master. Not confirmed available for the dates.
properties.availability_note: Shows in an undated Cedar Key 4BR+ search but not in the Dec 19-27 2026 dated search. Availability must be confirmed directly.

properties.name: Hampton House Homosassa Estate
properties.beds_note: All five bedrooms have SPLIT KING beds — the host will make each up as either a king or 2 twins on request. Bedroom 1 also has a single; Bedroom 4 also has a single. Host explicitly offers 'four couples and two singles' style configurations.
properties.price_note: Airbnb dated search Dec 19-27 2026 quoted $7,213 for 8 nights before taxes.
properties.why: Functionally the perfect bed layout for this exact group: every bedroom is a split king, so the host will set up three king rooms for the three couples and two twin rooms for the twenty-somethings, on request. Five bedrooms, five and a half baths, 1.8 waterfront acres in Old Homosassa with a floating dock, twenty minutes from Kings Bay in peak manatee season.
properties.cons: One of the more expensive options on this coast at ~$900/night. Old Homosassa is a fish-camp town with limited restaurants; it is a drive to anything else. Not Cedar Key, which the family named.
properties.availability_note: Returned in an Airbnb dated search for Dec 19-27 2026, 9 adults, min 5 bedrooms, quoted $7,213 for 8 nights.

properties.name: Private Waterfront Island Lodge (boat access only)
properties.neighborhood: Private island, Gulf of Mexico shoreline
properties.compound_note: A 2,800 sq ft main lodge sleeping 13 plus a separate bungalow sleeping 4, on one private island — the whole island books as a single listing.
properties.beds_note: Bedroom 1: 2 doubles + 1 single. Bedroom 2: king. Bedroom 3: queen. Bedroom 4: 2 queens. Bedroom 5: 2 doubles. Living room: king. Upstairs rooms are semi-private and each sleeps 4-5.
properties.price_note: Airbnb dated search Dec 19-27 2026 quoted $6,990 for 8 nights (was $7,609), before taxes.
amenities: own private island, quarter mile of Gulf shoreline
properties.why: The highest-character property in the whole region — your own private island off Homosassa with a quarter mile of Gulf shoreline, reachable only by boat, with manatees and dolphins in the front yard during peak December season. Nine adults would rattle around in it happily.
properties.cons: Boat access ONLY — every arrival, grocery run and restaurant trip is a boat trip, which over eight nights at Christmas with nine people is a serious logistical commitment. Only 2 kings and the second one is in the living room. Upstairs bedrooms are described as 'semi-private'. 3 baths for the group.
properties.availability_note: Returned in an Airbnb dated Dec 19-27 2026 search, 9 adults, min 5 bedrooms, quoted $6,990 for 8 nights.

properties.name: Bayshore Getaway — Crystal River 5BR Waterfront
properties.beds_note: Not fully stated on the listing page. Airbnb lists 6 beds across 5 bedrooms; the description confirms a king primary suite with balcony on the main level and a further bedroom on the ground level. Ask the host for the full king/queen breakdown.
properties.price_note: Airbnb dated search Dec 19-27 2026 quoted $6,818 for 8 nights before taxes.
amenities: arcade and game room, ping pong, air hockey
properties.why: Sleeps exactly 11 in beds across 5 bedrooms and 4.5 baths, minutes from Kings Bay where the manatees gather in December. An elevator, two kitchens, a game room and a tiki bar over a private dock make it a strong eight-night base for a mixed-age group.
properties.cons: Bed configuration is not published — the king count is unconfirmed and could be as low as one. Expensive at ~$850/night. The 'pool' is a 10x10, 3-ft dip pool, not a real pool. Owner's watercraft and lift are off-limits.
properties.availability_note: Returned in an Airbnb dated Dec 19-27 2026 search with a quoted total of $6,818 for 8 nights.

properties.name: Crystal River Waterfront on Kings Bay — 6BR with Dock
properties.beds_note: Bedroom 1: king. Bedroom 2: queen + 2 bunks. Bedroom 3: queen. Bedroom 4: king. Bedroom 5: queen + 1 bunk. Bedroom 6: 3 bunks. Living room: sofa bed + 3 couches.
properties.price_note: Airbnb dated search Dec 19-27 2026 quoted $7,517 for 8 nights before taxes.
amenities: game room with pool table, arcade, foosball, darts
properties.why: Right on Kings Bay itself, with a private dock you can launch kayaks from and paddle out among the manatees — the single biggest December draw in this region. Six bedrooms means everyone gets their own room with several to spare.
properties.cons: Only 2 kings and only 3 bathrooms for a house that sleeps 16 — thin for nine adults over eight nights. Half the sleeping is bunk beds, which reads as a big-family/kids house rather than an adults trip. Priciest per-head option in Crystal River.
properties.availability_note: Returned in an Airbnb dated Dec 19-27 2026 search, quoted $7,517 for 8 nights.

properties.name: The Manatee Home — waterfront with boat slip
properties.beds_note: Bedroom 1: king. Bedroom 2: 2 queens. Bedroom 3: 2 queens. Bedroom 4: 1 single + crib. Plus a sleeper sofa.
properties.price_note: Airbnb dated search Dec 19-27 2026 quoted $3,569 for 8 nights (was $3,944), before taxes.
properties.why: The best value waterfront house in Crystal River for these dates — under $450/night for a remodelled 5-bedroom with its own boat slip, minutes from the manatee springs, and confirmed in the dated search.
properties.cons: Only ONE king, and two of the bedrooms hold two queens each rather than one bed — so a couple would be sharing a room with a spare queen in it. Only 3 baths. The listing text is inconsistent (calls itself both 5-bed and 3-bed), so verify the layout before booking.
properties.availability_note: Returned in an Airbnb dated Dec 19-27 2026 search at $3,569 for 8 nights.

properties.name: Salty Pelican — Steinhatchee 5 Bedroom
properties.beds_note: Bedroom 1: king. Bedroom 2: king. Bedroom 3: queen + sofa bed. Bedroom 4: 2 singles + 2 bunks + floor mattress. Bedroom 5: sofa bed. 11 beds total.
properties.price_note: Airbnb dated search Dec 19-27 2026 quoted $5,992 for 8 nights before taxes.
properties.why: Two kings, a queen and four full baths in a purpose-built 5-bedroom group house with an elevator and three balconies — one of very few large, genuinely new houses in Steinhatchee, and confirmed available for the dates.
properties.cons: Only 2 kings, so the third couple is in the queen room (which also has a sofa bed in it). The fifth 'bedroom' is a sofa bed, and the fourth is a bunk-and-floor-mattress room — the real adult capacity is closer to 7-8 than 14. Steinhatchee is the most remote spot in this region, roughly 2.5 hours from Tampa.
properties.availability_note: Returned in an Airbnb dated Dec 19-27 2026 search at $5,992 for 8 nights.

properties.name: Anchor Hill — Steinhatchee Landing Resort
properties.compound_note: A private 4-bedroom house inside the 35-acre Steinhatchee Landing Resort. The resort's other cottages and houses (1-3BR, plus the 5BR Southern Pines Lodge) can be booked alongside it if the family wants a second unit — call the resort at 850-295-1526 to combine.
properties.beds_note: Bedroom 1: king. Bedroom 2: 3 bunk beds. Bedroom 3: king. Bedroom 4: queen. 9 beds total.
properties.price_note: Airbnb dated search Dec 19-27 2026 quoted $4,642 for 8 nights before taxes.
amenities: resort pool, hot tub and sauna
community docks on the Steinhatchee River
properties.why: A 4-bedroom house set inside the prettiest cottage resort on this coast — 35 acres of Victorian-style cottages on the Steinhatchee River with a pool, sauna, docks and a petting zoo, ideal for a slow eight-night Christmas. Two kings, a queen, and 3.5 baths, and it is confirmed bookable for the dates.
properties.cons: Only 4 bedrooms with 2 kings — the third couple takes the queen, and two twenty-somethings share the bunk room, which is a poor look for adults. Steinhatchee is remote and quiet; December there is very quiet indeed.
properties.availability_note: Returned in an Airbnb dated Dec 19-27 2026 search at $4,642 for 8 nights.

properties.name: Southern Pines Lodge — Steinhatchee Landing Resort
properties.compound_note: One of the largest single lodges in the 35-acre Steinhatchee Landing Resort, across from the pool and a short walk to the docks; the resort's other cottages can be added for overflow. Managed by Steinhatchee Retreats (904-707-7654 / 352-356-7100).
properties.beds_note: Downstairs bedroom: king with accessible bath. Bedroom 2: 3 twins (roll-away available). Bedroom 3: king with private bath. Bedroom 4: 2 queens with private bath. Game room: small bedroom with 2 bunk sets. 4 full + 2 half baths.
properties.price_note: Rate not published on the agency page and Vrbo search/listing fetches returned HTTP 429. Call for a Dec 19-27 2026 quote.
amenities: community pool, hot tub and sauna
boat slips and docks on the Steinhatchee River
wrap-around porch with swing and rockers
properties.why: Five bedrooms, four full and two half baths, two kings and two queens, plus a ground-floor accessible king suite — the closest thing in Steinhatchee to a proper lodge for nine adults, set inside the riverfront resort with pool, sauna and docks.
properties.cons: Only 2 kings — the third couple would be in one of the two queens sharing a room. No published rate and no confirmed Dec 2026 availability; everything has to go through a phone call. Vrbo blocked the fetch so bed details come from the agency page only.
properties.availability_note: Agency page carries no live calendar; Vrbo listing #807570 returned HTTP 429 on fetch. Confirm by phone.

properties.name: River Front Retreat — 6BR on the Rainbow River
properties.beds_note: Bedroom 1: king. Bedroom 2: king + 1 single. Bedroom 3: queen. Bedroom 4: queen. Bedroom 5: king + 1 single. Bedroom 6: king + 1 single.
properties.price_note: Airbnb dated search Dec 19-27 2026 quoted $12,765 for 8 nights (was $13,955), before taxes.

minutes to KP Hole and Rainbow Springs
properties.why: The best-appointed house in the region for a group like this: six bedrooms with four kings and two queens, 4.5 baths, and 137 feet of frontage on the spring-fed Rainbow River — 72-degree, gin-clear water you can swim in on Christmas Day.

properties.availability_note: Returned in an Airbnb dated Dec 19-27 2026 search at $12,765 for 8 nights.

properties.cons: Only 2 kings and only 2.5 baths for nine adults over eight nights. Bedrooms are loaded with mixed extra beds rather than one bed per room. Inland — no Gulf, no manatees on site. Three-night minimum, pets not allowed.
properties.availability_note: Returned in an Airbnb dated Dec 19-27 2026 search at $6,325 for 8 nights.

properties.name: Hernando by the Sea — 6BR Waterfront, Direct Gulf

properties.price_note: Airbnb dated search Dec 19-27 2026 quoted $3,588 for 8 nights before taxes.

properties.why: Six separate bedrooms — one per person if they want it — on a Gulf-access canal with a private dock and kayaks, for under $450 a night. 4.96 stars over 49 reviews. The cheapest way to give nine adults nine doors.
